newsitem.title: FRANCE: French audit to be published immediately - source.
newsitem.headline: French audit to be published immediately - source.

text.p: The results of an audit of public finances due on July 21 will be published immediately, a Finance Ministry source said on Wednesday.

The new Socialist-led government has called on two independent officials from the National Accounts Commission to study the state of public finances before deciding what needs to be done to meet France's commitment to be ready for European Monetary Union in 1999.
The source declined to comment on the likely size of the budget deficit, though one government source has said it could exceed 3.4 to 3.5 percent of gross domestic product.
"The figures which come out of the audit will be the ones that count," he said. The results of the audit "will be made public immediately," he added.
